ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  DCB Bank Limited announced the allotment of 71,260 equity shares to its employees on July 30, 2026, under its Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP). This routine corporate action increased the bank's issued and paid-up share capital from 322,077,427 to 322,148,687 equity shares, resulting in a very minor dilution for existing shareholders. There are no material adverse impacts or red flags associated with this standard employee incentivization practice.
